Analytic replay: first-passage Laplace transform and stopped drift/cubic identities in rationale; use Eτ³=(Eτ)³+3Eτ Var(τ)+third cumulant, then divide occupation rewards by Eτ.
correctness.rationale: The finite-mean continuous first-passage cycle gives the stationary occupation law; before its hit the drift is −v and variance rate is 2D. The killed resolvent has the Dirichlet image term and the correct forward-density tilt e^[v(L−x)/(2D)]. Its negative log derivative at zero gives 2D/v²+|x−L|/v−2m/[v(e^(vm/D)−1)]. For x<L the derivative has sign opposite to sinh(vx/D)−vx/D; for x>L it is 1/v. The continuous version is therefore uniquely minimized at L, with the asserted zero-side limit. Independently, for the stopped process at x=L, E[X_t;τ>t]=v E[(τ−t)_+] by stopped expectation. Thus U_x=v Eτ²/2 and V_x=v Eτ³/6, while U₁=Eτ and V₁=Eτ²/2. Differentiating E exp(−sτ)=exp[(v−√(v²+4Ds))L/(2D)] gives the mean, variance and third cumulant L/v, 2DL/v³ and 12D²L/v⁵, respectively. The stopped cubic identity gives U_x²=L³/(3v)+2D U_x/v (here U_x² denotes the potential of x↦x²). Substitution into the equilibrium occupation means gives Var(X)=L²/12+D²/v² and Cov(X,A)=D²/v³−L²/(12v). By the Markov property E[R|X=x]=x/v, giving Cov(X,R)=Var(X)/v. The renewal survivor identity gives equal marginals of A and R and is consistent with their different marked covariances. All stopped moment limits are justified by Gaussian survival bounds for large time and polynomial moment bounds. The age sign changes exactly at vL/(2D)=√3.
residual_risks: This is a formula for the continuous conditional-mean version on x>0, not a claim at the zero-mass boundary or an ordering of the full conditional age laws. No entropy-production claim follows.

value.rationale: Age and residual are the natural two time directions of a stationary cycle. Position distinguishes them even when their marginals are identical: one covariance can be negative or vanish while the other stays positive, with a sharp nondimensional threshold. This identifies what a spatial inspection can reveal about time direction, and the conditional minimum determines where the particle is, on average, most recently reinjected. Those are concrete, usable properties of the standard model, not merely new notation for the Green function.
residual_risks: The result is a second-moment and conditional-mean characterization in the specified model. It does not classify path reversal, entropy production or resetting mechanisms in general.
